queries.label: Top 10 Denied Source IPs
queries.query:
SophosXGFirewall 
| where Log_Type == "Firewall" and Status == "Deny" 
| summarize count() by Src_IP 
| top 10 by count_

queries.label: Top 10 Denied Destination IPs
queries.query:
SophosXGFirewall 
| where Log_Type == "Firewall" and Status == "Deny" 
| summarize count() by Dst_IP 
| top 10 by count_

queries.label: IsConnectedQuery
queries.query:
SophosXGFirewall 
      | summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
            | project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(30d)

queries.label: Syslog (SophosXGFirewall)
queries.query:
SophosXGFirewall 
            | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
            | where isnotempty(Time)
